reason: $2,000 up front before I have seen it work is a lot, and I run my week out of a paper agenda and texts. I would probably call the demo line and maybe book the free demo, but I would not pay anything this month.
objection: The refund only needs 10 missed requests in 60 days. That could be wrong numbers and people shopping prices, and I would still be out $249 a month. Ten requests is not ten jobs, so the guarantee does not really cover me.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with another owner in my area who shows me how many of the calls it caught turned into paid jobs, and a setup fee that is lowered or credited against the first months if it does not.
